items.title: 8.4.2 Key Principles of Research Ethics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4.2 (PDF 201), with MCQs 7-8 and short question 6 as self-checks.

items: Informed Consent (soch samajh kar di gayi ijazat): participants ko hamesha research ka maqsad batayein aur study mein shamil karne se pehle un ki ijazat lein.
Confidentiality (raazdari): participants ki zaati maloomat aur jawab private rakhein aur ijazat ke baghair kisi ko na batayein.
Integrity (imandari): research mein imandar aur transparent (saaf, kuch na chhupane wale) rahein. Data na ghadhein, plagiarism na karein aur apne nateeje ko ghalat tareeqe se pesh na karein.
Respect for Participants (participants ki izzat): sab participants se izzat se pesh aayein aur pakka karein ke research unhein kisi bhi tarah nuqsan na de.

blocks.text: Avoiding Bias (tarafdari se bachna): research insaf se aur unbiased (kisi taraf jhukao ke baghair) tareeqe se karein, aur apne nateeje sirf jama kiye gaye saboot (evidence) par rakhein. (Kitab ne yeh paanchwan usool number ke baghair alag line mein chhapa hai.)

items: Kisi aise research project ki case study parhein jahan ethical guidelines follow nahi ki gayin (maslan aisi study jis mein participants ki privacy ka khayal nahi rakha gaya).
Groups mein baat karein ke kya ghalat hua aur yeh kaam ethical tareeqe se kaise ho sakta tha.
Apne group ke nateeje likhein aur class ke saath share karein.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: jis study mein participants ki privacy ka khayal na rakha gaya ho, us mein aam taur par kya ghalat hota hai aur ethical tareeqa kya hota?
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par zaati maloomat bina ijazat jama ki gayi ya doosron ko bata di gayi. Ethical tareeqa: participants ko maqsad batana aur ijazat lena (informed consent), data se naam hata dena aur use mehfooz rakhna (confidentiality), aur bina ijazat kisi se share na karna.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain ke research ki ethical guidelines bohat saalon mein banayi gayi hain ta ke participants mehfooz rahein aur research society ke liye faida mand ho? In par chal kar aap apne kaam par logon ka bharosa banate hain aur sab ki bhalai mein hissa dalte hain. Yaad rakhein, ethical researcher hone ka matlab sirf rules manna nahi, balki apni har research mein imandar, insaf karne wala aur izzat dene wala hona hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethical research ka zaroori hissa kaunsa hai? (MCQ 7)  Nateeje ko sachai aur transparency (kuch na chhupana) se report karna kis usool mein aata hai? (MCQ 8)  Researcher apni study mein bias se kaise bache? (Short question 6)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 7: (b) Avoiding plagiarism and providing proper credit. MCQ 8: (b) Integrity; kitab ke mutabiq integrity ka matlab honest aur transparent rehna aur nateeje ghalat pesh na karna hai. (Kitab ki answer key MCQ 8 ke liye (a) Confidentiality deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khata.) Short question 6: kitab ke mutabiq research fair aur unbiased tareeqe se karein aur nateeje sirf jama kiye saboot par rakhein. Practical tareeqe (aam ilm): data jama karne se pehle sawal aur tareeqa tay kar lein, participants insaf se chunein, sab nateeje likhein chahe woh expectations (umeed) ke khilaf hon, aur apni pasand ke bajaye saboot ko faisla karne dein.

items: Paanch usool: Informed Consent, Confidentiality, Integrity, Respect for Participants, Avoiding Bias.
Ethical researcher imandar, insaf karne wala aur izzat dene wala hota hai.
